column1: # Line-end hyphens in the SRD transcripts that the document's own vocabulary cannot decide.
# Read by scripts/srd/readable.py; a form listed here overrides its default. A new PDF or version
# reports any form not listed (--report), to be decided and added here.
# decision: keep = a real compound ("long-dead"); join = a word split by the line break ("Halberds").
# evidence: 5etools = the same word appears in 5etools text in that form only;
#           eye     = absent from 5etools, decided by reading (syllable splits, plain compounds).
